meta.title: 3otla — Public holidays in Morocco
meta.description: Every public holiday in Morocco, national and religious, with its status (fixed, estimated, confirmed) and official source. Calendar, countdown and a free API.
meta.yearDescription: {year} calendar of public holidays in Morocco: national and religious holidays, estimated and confirmed dates, with official sources.
meta.holidayDescription: {name} {year} in Morocco: {date}. Status: {status}. Official source and countdown.

home.intro: Morocco’s public holidays, each date with its status and official source.

status.fixedHelp: Same date every year, set by official texts.
status.estimatedHelp: Estimated with the Umm al-Qura calendar. In Morocco the date depends on moon sighting and can be one day later.
status.confirmedHelp: Date officially announced by the Ministry of Habous and Islamic Affairs.

holiday.estimateNote: Estimated date: it will be confirmed after the official moon-sighting announcement.

calendar.count: {count, plural, one {# public holiday} other {# public holidays}}

subscribe.title: Add to your calendar
subscribe.hint: Estimated dates update automatically once confirmed.

sources.title: Sources and method
sources.intro: Every date on 3otla shows its status and links to an official source. We never use aggregators or news sites as sources.
sources.nationalBody: National holidays follow the official list published on Morocco’s national portal (maroc.ma) and the corresponding decrees.
sources.religiousBody: Religious holiday dates are first estimated with the Umm al-Qura calendar. Morocco sets these dates by local moon sighting, so the actual date can be one day later. Once the Ministry of Habous announces the date, it becomes “confirmed” with a link to the announcement.
sources.correctionsBody: The data is public and versioned on GitHub. Every correction must cite an official source.
sources.licenseBody: Data under CC BY 4.0, code under MIT.

footer.tagline: Morocco’s public holidays, with their sources.

school.metaDescription: Official {schoolYear} school holiday calendar in Morocco: public schools (Ministry of National Education) and French schools (AEFE), with official sources.
school.intro: Morocco’s official school holidays, from the calendars published by the Ministry of National Education and, for French schools, by the French Embassy.
school.notHolidays: School breaks are not public holidays: they don’t change working days. Public holidays come on top of them.
school.publicSub: Ministry of National Education, Preschool and Sports
school.over: All breaks of this school year are over.
